desc: Parse input; build arrays src[26], dst[26] from position pairs; validate each source letter maps to at most one target, else print -1.
Build the functional graph f[26] (f[x]=y if x must become y, x≠y); mark letters that are "fixed" (only self requirements) and letters with no requirement.
Compute in-degree considering only non-self edges; identify nodes belonging to cycles via standard functional-graph cycle detection (e.g., visited-state DFS or in-degree elimination).
For each cycle, check whether any cycle node has an incoming edge from a node outside the cycle; flag pure vs non-pure cycles.
Answer = (number of non-self edges) + (number of pure cycles); handle S==T naturally (0 edges → 0).
Implement iterative O(N + 26) solution in Python with fast I/O, then verify against the four samples mentally (4, 0, -1, 4).
